summary: NeuroSense Therapeutics Ltd., an Israeli pharmaceutical company, filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval at a Special Meeting held August 26, 2026, authorizing its Board of Directors to effect one or more reverse share splits of its ordinary shares at an aggregate ratio ranging from 1-for-4 to 1-for-40. The exact ratio and effective date, if any, are to be determined by the Board within 12 months of the meeting. Shareholders also approved that no amendment to the Articles of Association is required. This is a routine corporate governance action, not a special situation; the reverse split is discretionary and its purpose (e.g., regaining listing compliance) is not stated.
